statement.zh: 三星堆衰落后天府平原礼仪—政治中心「迁至」金沙的简单迁都叙事，仍属假说。
statement.en: A simple narrative that the Chengdu Plain ritual–political center ‘moved’ from Sanxingdui to Jinsha remains a hypothesis.
